description: A resource manifest applied to an Airdress operator.

namespace.description: Accepted for k8s familiarity but ignored — every operator manages one airdress's resources (one namespace).

resourceVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token. When present, apply is rejected with 409 if the stored row's `resource_version` doesn't match. When absent, last-writer-wins.

spec.description: A device linked to this airdress: it publishes the declared events under its own machine signature and takes the declared commands. The machine it names holds no grants.

channel.description: How commands reach the thing. Mode defaults to held when commands are declared, otherwise off.

oneOf.description: A held long-poll, rotated every 240 s.
A device that sleeps: it polls with `wait: 0` when it wakes.

mode.description: `off`, `held` or `wake`. Absent: held with commands, else off.

commands.description: The commands a function may send this thing, each with its own per-minute limit.

perMinute.description: Sends a minute, across every function.

enabled.description: When false every event is refused and no command reaches the thing. Default true.

events.description: The events this thing may publish, and their limits.

maxBodyBytes.description: The largest events request body, in bytes. At most the operator's ceiling.

perMinute.description: Live events a minute (burst 20). Events more than 10 s old at receipt are backlog and have a separate budget of the operator's backlog multiplier times this (10 by default). At most the operator's ceiling.

types.description: The event types the thing may publish; an undeclared type is refused per event. Each becomes the CloudEvent type dev.airdress.thing.<type>.

machine.description: The id of the approved machine this thing enrolled as (see `airdress-operator machines list`). One Thing per machine.

title: Airdress operator Thing manifest
